top_needs.title: Reduction in treatment duration and appointment frequency with DM vs standard care
top_needs.brands_and_products: Invisalign, Spark, Angel, Damon braces, Damon Ultima, self-ligating brackets, SmartSTL, DM ScanBox
top_needs.metrics_sought: treatment duration in months, number of visits reduction, chair time minutes saved per appointment, percentage of cases with reduced refinements
top_needs.doctor_objections: Orthodontists question whether remote monitoring truly shortens treatment or just shifts workload. Some believe frequent in-person visits are essential and doubt DM can reduce appointment frequency without compromising care. Others are skeptical about claims of fewer refinements or faster aligner progression.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: peer-reviewed RCTs comparing treatment duration with and without DM, retrospective cohort studies on appointment frequency, before/after case galleries showing time savings
sample_queries: Impact on treatment duration
Clinical studies and evidence on the reduction on visits with DM for Braces treatments.
Evidence that DM reduces number of visits for braces cases
Reduced chairtime and academic publication
top_needs.gap_assessment: High-quality comparative studies quantifying treatment time and visit reductions with DM, especially for braces, are scarce. Prioritize creating robust RCTs and real-world data analyses demonstrating these time savings.

top_needs.title: Accuracy and reliability of DM AI tooth movement detection vs clinical assessment
top_needs.brands_and_products: DM AI, SmartSTL, Invisalign, Spark, Damon braces
top_needs.metrics_sought: AI sensitivity and specificity percentages, mean bias in mm for occlusal parameters, accuracy rates compared to in-person exams, FDA clearance data
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors doubt AI's ability to detect subtle clinical changes remotely and worry about false positives/negatives. Some patients question AI findings, leading to skepticism about DM's diagnostic reliability.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: product accuracy validation studies, peer-reviewed clinical validation papers, regulatory clearance documentation, sensitivity/specificity analyses
sample_queries: Information on the accuracy of DM, a patient has questioned the ability of the AI to detect clinical observations
paper on AI accuracy
Specificity and sensitivity results for FDA application
Occlusal Assessment: A quantitative study validating the AI’s accuracy in detecting malocclusions
top_needs.gap_assessment: More accessible, detailed validation studies with clear accuracy metrics and clinical comparisons are needed to reassure skeptical doctors and patients.

top_needs.title: Practice workflow improvements and staff efficiency gains integrating DM
top_needs.brands_and_products: DM platform, DM ScanBox, Damon braces, SmartSTL
top_needs.metrics_sought: staff time saved per week, appointment scheduling efficiency, patient no-show rate changes, staff satisfaction scores
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors worry DM integration complicates workflows or adds staff burden. Some fear it disrupts existing scheduling or requires extra training without clear efficiency gains.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: white papers with practice data, case studies on workflow integration, staff satisfaction surveys, ROI calculators
sample_queries: Understanding of how our practice can benefit from DM
Explain to that prospect what integrating DM means concretely for them and their team
EMEA Doctors, effecting staff efficiency
How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits
top_needs.gap_assessment: Detailed, region-specific workflow case studies and ROI analyses demonstrating concrete staff time savings and satisfaction improvements are missing and should be prioritized.

top_needs.metrics_sought: cost savings per patient, increased patient throughput, revenue impact, appointment reduction translating to financial gains
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors question whether DM just adds costs without clear financial return. Some doubt if reduced visits or chair time translate into real profit or just shift workload.

ROI Braces

I need a clear ROI
top_needs.gap_assessment: Comprehensive ROI models and financial case studies tailored to different practice sizes and regions are lacking and would help overcome cost objections.
